rows.note: This is the everyday choice for putting pieces together, especially when assembling a model or object.

example.traditional: 我哋一齊砌呢盒模型啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 cai3 ni1 hap6 mou4 jing4 laa1

rows.note: Use this when people gather together as a group at a place.

example.english: Everyone, assemble at the playground at eight in the morning.
example.traditional: 大家朝早八點喺操場集合。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 hai2 cou1 coeng4 zaap6 hap6
